rationale: Mufaddal brings 15+ years of embedded systems and automotive software expertise—including embedded Linux, Bluetooth, OTA updates, and automotive-grade delivery across Harley-Davidson LiveWire, Volkswagen, and legacy OEMs—while Deep leads automotive software strategy at Valeo with focus on reliability and engineering talent growth. They can exchange technical depth on embedded automotive challenges and explore how Mufaddal's independent consulting background might complement Valeo's segment leadership needs.
intro_message: Mufaddal, meet Deep—a Segment Tech Lead at Valeo focused on automotive software reliability and talent scaling; your LiveWire and VW embedded systems background could be a valuable conversation on the future of automotive software architecture.
